> Whenever possible, please mention and cite Multiwfn in main text rather than in supplemental information, otherwise not only Multiwfn will be difficult for readers to notice, but also the paper will not be included in citation statistics.

## Project status and recording rules

- No separate author authorization for this integration is recorded.
- These terms notes do not establish relicensing/paid-distribution boundaries;
  obtain written confirmation when needed.
- Code citations do not replace research-paper main-text citations.
- Preserve historical terms when they change; add records and link the applicable
  version in provenance, rather than silently replacing history.
- Record extra grants only for evidenced modules/versions/scopes. Do not extend a
  one-time grant to all future implementations.
